findings.claim_text: Axios filed at 16:00:19 UTC — nineteen seconds after Google's post went live.[^8] Nineteen seconds is not writeable from scratch: it is not enough time to read a two-memo post, confirm that a 27-year Chief Scientist is leaving, and publish. It is exactly enough time to press publish on copy already written, edited and lawyered against an embargo.
From `gemini-3.1-pro-preview` on 19 February 2026 to reorg day is 167 days with no successor at the tier that sets the frontier.[^19]
The reorganization is not even the largest AI-driven drawdown of the preceding three weeks.
